# Vibe Design

> 30 bilingual web style studies for adapting existing projects, with source-derived tokens and reusable project rules.

## Start here

- [Agent index](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/index.md): styles, versions and DESIGN.md downloads
- [Full reference](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/llms-full.txt): all style documents and project baselines
- [Install the portable Skill](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/skill.md): installation instructions

## Style references

- [Apple Minimalism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/apple.md): Center the product: short headlines, large product imagery, clear benefits and restrained sections. System sans-serif, tight display tracking and consistent spacing; reserve blue for links and primary actions. Let material and whitespace establish hierarchy.
- [Braun / Dieter Rams](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/braun.md): Use a modular grid and functional grouping. Align labels, scales and controls. Neutral grays, clear labeling and restrained functional color; tactile material details serve use.
- [Flat Design](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/flat.md): Organize tasks with solid color regions, clear typography and simple icons. Solid fills, clear boundaries and consistent icon strokes; hierarchy comes from contrast and position.
- [Material Design](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/material.md): Organize UI around Material 3 color roles, type scale, shape and state. This study uses a purple primary, tonal surfaces and Roboto; its 56px FAB has 16px corners with clear hover and pressed feedback.
- [Swiss Style / International Typographic](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/swiss.md): Build an asymmetric grid with shared axes for headlines, rules, numbers and body copy. Use neo-grotesque type weight, spacing and scale to establish order; red carries emphasis in this study.
- [Bento Grid](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/bento.md): Arrange different amounts of information in a hierarchical modular grid; spanning cells carry the main story. This study uses 24px desktop card corners, white-gray surfaces and selective blue-violet accents, reordered for mobile.
- [Aurora Gradients](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/aurora.md): Use broad soft gradients as atmosphere while keeping copy and product areas stable. Blend warm and cool bands smoothly; control blur and luminance and carry accent color into select actions.
- [Bauhaus](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/bauhaus.md): Let geometry, typography and space form an asymmetric structure together. Cream, red-yellow-blue and geometric construction express experimentation in this study; color and form have clear relationships.
- [Scandinavian](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/scandinavian.md): Center everyday settings and natural materials, with clear product information and generous space. Warm white, wood and sage, soft lighting and textile detail, with modern warm typography.
- [Neo-Brutalism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/neo-brutalism.md): Organize content with clear regions, heavy borders and emphatic hierarchy. This study uses black hard-edged shadows, bold color blocks and heavy headings; shadows contract on press.
- [Duotone](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/duotone.md): Carry two tonal families through type, regions and images, controlling the mapping between shadows and highlights. This study maps shadows to deep navy and highlights to orange, including image treatment.
- [Japanese Minimalism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/japanese.md): Use negative space, natural rhythm and careful content proportions. This study pairs paper tones, fine rules, serif headings and small vermilion accents; copy length sets the rhythm.
- [Organic Design](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/organic.md): Create a flowing composition with asymmetric curves and natural imagery while keeping text clear. Shapes share a coherent curvature; gentle colors and forms guide reading.
- [Liquid Glass](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/liquid-glass.md): Place floating navigation and controls above a clear content layer; avoid turning all content into glass. Focus on lensing, edge highlights, adaptive shadows and legibility over changing content; both light and dark contexts are valid.
- [Editorial](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/editorial.md): Masthead, article hierarchy, column measure, captions and fine rules establish reading order. Serif headlines, compact body copy, a drop cap and a lead image set the reading rhythm in this study.
- [Brutalism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/brutalism.md): Use direct document structure, emphatic type and visible links for a raw web character. This study uses browser-like serif type, square corners, fine rules and link blue with dense content.
- [Terminal](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/terminal.md): Organize content as commands, output, logs and status in a terminal reading sequence. Monospace type, a limited palette, cursor and explicit success/error states.
- [Memphis](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/memphis.md): Build a playful layout through rhythmic geometry, patterns and color blocks. Squiggles, dots, diagonals and clashing colors are arranged around the headline and objects in this study.
- [Art Deco](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/art-deco.md): Create ceremony with symmetry, stepped composition and ornamental framing. This study uses green-black, fine gold lines, radiating forms and widely spaced headlines.
- [Glassmorphism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/glassmorphism.md): Place a small number of translucent panels over a background with visible color and form. Backdrop blur, transparent fills, fine light borders and moderate shadows express frosted glass; the background must remain perceptible.
- [Dark Academia](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/dark-academia.md): Organize content around books, scholarship and reading, with a long-form typographic hierarchy. Dark wood, forest green, wine and parchment with restrained serif type and material detail.
- [Pixel Art](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/pixel.md): Build on a consistent pixel unit and arrange information like a game HUD. Limited palette, stepped edges, hard shadows and stepped motion; type and sprites share a pixel rhythm.
- [Cyberpunk](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/cyberpunk.md): Use strong light-dark contrast, technical labeling and asymmetric information regions for a futuristic urban character. Use cyan, magenta and warning colors selectively over dark surfaces; clipped corners and brief glitches support hierarchy.
- [Frutiger Aero](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/frutiger-aero.md): Combine natural imagery and optimistic technology in one bright scene. Sky, water, grass green, translucent highlights and soft corners, with consistent lighting and reflection.
- [Claymorphism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/claymorphism.md): Focus on a few voluminous characters or controls with space around them. Soft corners, inset highlights and tinted cast shadows create an inflated volume under consistent lighting.
- [Vaporwave](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/vaporwave.md): Combine retro windows, perspective grids and surreal imagery into a nostalgic scene. This study uses pink, cyan and violet while retaining a distinct foreground text layer.
- [Maximalism](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/maximalism.md): Establish a dominant visual, then enrich it with secondary type, patterns and layered content. High density, multiple scales and vivid colors coexist with hierarchy, repetition and echoes.
- [Kinetic Typography](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/kinetic.md): Use moving type for rhythm and storytelling while preserving a complete static reading structure. Choreograph speed, displacement, spacing and weight; provide pause and respect reduced motion.
- [Anti-Design](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/anti-design.md): Break selected alignment and typographic conventions while keeping navigation and content order understandable. Clashing primaries, displaced labels and mixed type create controlled tension in this study.
- [Neumorphism / Soft UI](https://v2ai.org/vibe-design/markdown/styles/neumorphism.md): Organize a small number of controls through raised and inset forms on one base material. Paired light and dark shadows share a lighting direction; labels and selection need explicit clarity.
